disclaimer: These are original practice questions, not verified previous-year questions.

questions.question: Who chaired the Drafting Committee of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: B. R. Ambedkar chaired the Constitution's Drafting Committee.

questions.question: Article 17 of the Constitution abolishes what?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability.

questions.question: Which Article guarantees equality before the law?
questions.explanation: Article 14 provides equality before law and equal protection of laws.

questions.question: In which part are the Directive Principles of State Policy?
questions.explanation: Directive Principles are contained in Part IV.

questions.question: How many Fundamental Duties does the Constitution list?
questions.explanation: There are 11 Fundamental Duties under Article 51A.

questions.question: The Eighth Schedule of the Constitution deals with what?
questions.explanation: The Eighth Schedule lists recognised languages.

questions.question: What is the minimum age for membership of the Lok Sabha?
questions.explanation: Article 84 specifies a minimum age of 25.

questions.question: What is the minimum age to join the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: Article 84 sets a minimum age of 30.

questions.question: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment concerns which body?
questions.explanation: The 73rd Amendment gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions.

questions.question: Who is the ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The Vice President is ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Which part contains Fundamental Rights?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Rights are in Part III.

questions.question: Under which Article can the President proclaim a national emergency?
questions.explanation: Article 352 governs a national emergency.

questions.question: In which year was the Indian National Congress founded?
questions.explanation: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885.

questions.question: Who launched the Quit India Movement in 1942?
questions.explanation: The Quit India Movement was led by Mahatma Gandhi in August 1942.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred in which year?
questions.explanation: The massacre took place on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: In which year was the Battle of Plassey fought?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757.

questions.question: Who was India's first Indian Governor-General?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari served as the first Indian Governor-General.

questions.question: Who wrote Vande Mataram?
questions.explanation: Vande Mataram was written by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.

questions.question: Where did the Dandi March end?
questions.explanation: Gandhi walked from Sabarmati to the coastal village of Dandi.

questions.question: Who founded the Brahmo Samaj?
questions.explanation: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded the movement.

questions.question: Who founded the Mauryan Empire?
questions.explanation: Chandragupta Maurya established the Mauryan Empire.

questions.question: Who commissioned the Taj Mahal?
questions.explanation: Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal in memory of Mumtaz Mahal.

questions.question: What is India's largest state by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is India's largest state by area.

questions.question: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.explanation: Gujarat has the longest state coastline.

questions.question: Which river is called Dakshin Ganga?
questions.explanation: Godavari is often called the Ganga of the South.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.explanation: The Tropic of Cancer crosses eight states.

questions.question: Which strait separates India and Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: Palk Strait lies between Tamil Nadu and northern Sri Lanka.

questions.question: Where is Kaziranga National Park situated?
questions.explanation: Kaziranga National Park is located in Assam.

questions.question: Which is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.explanation: The Sahara is the largest hot desert.

questions.question: Which mountain range contains Siachen Glacier?
questions.explanation: Siachen lies in the eastern Karakoram range.

questions.question: Which hill region connects the Eastern and Western Ghats?
questions.explanation: The Nilgiri Hills form a meeting region of the Ghats.

questions.question: Which gas makes up most of the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: About 78% of dry air is nitrogen.

questions.question: Which organ produces insulin?
questions.explanation: Insulin is released by beta cells in the pancreas.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula for common salt?
questions.explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride (NaCl).

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.explanation: Electric current is measured in amperes.

questions.question: What is the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce ATP through cellular respiration.

questions.question: Which vitamin can the skin synthesise in sunlight?
questions.explanation: UVB exposure stimulates production of vitamin D.

questions.question: Pure water has what pH at 25°C?
questions.explanation: Pure water is neutral at pH 7 at 25°C.

questions.question: Which instrument measures atmospheric pressure?
questions.explanation: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: What is the approximate speed of light in vacuum?
questions.explanation: Light travels approximately 300 million metres per second.

questions.question: Which acid occurs in lemons?
questions.explanation: Lemon juice contains citric acid.

questions.question: Which part of the brain coordinates balance?
questions.explanation: The cerebellum regulates balance and coordinated movement.

questions.question: What does GDP stand for?
questions.explanation: GDP is the total monetary value of final goods and services produced within an economy in a period.

questions.question: Where is the RBI headquartered?
questions.explanation: The RBI central office is in Mumbai.

questions.question: Which institution normally issues banknotes in India?
questions.explanation: The RBI issues most banknotes except the one-rupee note.

questions.question: Which tax was launched in India on 1 July 2017?
questions.explanation: Goods and Services Tax began on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: What does a repo rate refer to?
options: Rate for RBI lending to banks against eligible securities
questions.explanation: The policy repo rate applies to short-term liquidity against collateral.

questions.question: Which organisation is the apex rural development bank?
questions.explanation: NABARD supports agriculture and rural development.

questions.question: Which is an example of a direct tax?
questions.explanation: Income tax is imposed directly on taxable income.

questions.question: In which year did India's first passenger train run?
questions.explanation: The first passenger train ran between Bori Bunder and Thane in 1853.

questions.question: What is the width of Indian broad-gauge track?
questions.explanation: Indian broad gauge is 1,676 mm.

questions.question: What does IRCTC stand for?
options: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation
Indian Rail Coaching and Ticket Company
questions.explanation: IRCTC means Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation.

questions.question: Where is Integral Coach Factory located?
questions.explanation: The Integral Coach Factory is in Perambur, Chennai.

questions.question: Where is Rail Coach Factory situated?
questions.explanation: Rail Coach Factory is located at Kapurthala, Punjab.

questions.question: What does RPF stand for?
questions.explanation: RPF is the Railway Protection Force.

questions.question: Where is Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus?
questions.explanation: CSMT is a historic major terminus in Mumbai.

questions.question: What does CPU stand for?
questions.explanation: CPU means Central Processing Unit.

questions.question: Which memory is volatile?
questions.explanation: RAM loses contents when power is removed.

questions.question: Which Windows shortcut copies selected text?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+C copies selected text or items.

questions.question: What does URL stand for?
questions.explanation: A URL identifies an internet resource.

questions.question: What does HTTPS provide?
questions.explanation: HTTPS protects HTTP data using TLS.

questions.question: Project Tiger was launched in which year?
questions.explanation: Project Tiger began in 1973.

questions.question: Which treaty concerns wetlands of international importance?
questions.explanation: The Ramsar Convention promotes wetland conservation.

questions.question: Where is most atmospheric ozone concentrated?
questions.explanation: The ozone layer is mainly in the stratosphere.

questions.question: Which is a renewable energy source?
questions.explanation: Wind energy is renewable.

questions.question: Where is Konark Sun Temple located?
questions.explanation: Konark Sun Temple is in Odisha.

questions.question: Which classical dance belongs to Kerala?
questions.explanation: Kathakali is a classical dance-drama from Kerala.

questions.question: Who wrote the book Gitanjali?
questions.explanation: Tagore's Gitanjali is a celebrated poetry collection.

questions.question: Where is the Golden Temple located?
questions.explanation: The Golden Temple is in Amritsar.

questions.question: What does ISRO stand for?
questions.explanation: ISRO is India's national space agency.

questions.question: Where is Satish Dhawan Space Centre?
questions.explanation: The Satish Dhawan Space Centre is at Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh.

questions.question: When did Chandrayaan-3 land on the Moon?
questions.explanation: The Vikram lander made a soft landing on 23 August 2023.

questions.question: Which Indian solar mission operates near Sun–Earth L1?
questions.explanation: Aditya-L1 is dedicated to studying the Sun.
